$comment: Planned packs shown in the catalog. Votes are thumbs-up reactions on the request issue; scripts/refresh_roadmap.py creates missing issues and refreshes the counts. Status: coming-soon = the team will build it; candidate = depends on the vendor (licence, official repository).

planned.name: app-modernization
planned.description: Bring legacy screens to Carbon with IBM's UI modernization skills and modernize application code (Java EE to Quarkus, WebSphere) with watsonx Code Assistant guidance.

planned.name: building-blocks
planned.description: Bob modes from IBM Client Engineering: agent builder, RAG builder, text-to-SQL, data quality. Modes and MCP configuration instead of skills.

planned.name: dev-workflow
planned.description: Plan before implementing, review code, diagnose bugs, write architecture decision records. Original IBM skills for the everyday loop, the second most installed category on public skill directories.

planned.name: data-analyst
planned.description: Ask a question of a CSV, Excel file, SQLite, PostgreSQL or Db2 table and get the query, the profile of the data and a chart, then the report through office-docs and presentations. watsonx.data and the data catalogue come in through IBM's own MCP servers.
planned.source: IBM/ibm-watsonxdata-mcp-server and IBM/data-intelligence-mcp-server, plus our own skills

planned.name: log-triage
planned.description: Parsers for JSON, syslog, Java stack traces and OpenShift and Cloud Pak logs, error clustering, a timeline correlated by request id, and a report with root-cause hypotheses. Everything runs on the machine, so logs and the secrets in them stay there.

planned.name: redhat-openshift
planned.description: Cluster troubleshooting with scripts, cluster updates, GitOps with an Argo knowledge base, and token lookup, curated from Red Hat's own OpenShift skills. Ansible follows when Red Hat publishes skills for it.

planned.name: hashicorp-packer
planned.description: AWS and Azure image builders, Windows builder and push-to-registry skills from hashicorp/agent-skills.

planned.name: microsoft-azure-sdk-python
planned.description: Forty skills for the Azure SDKs in Python: identity, storage, Cosmos DB, AI services, monitoring, messaging.

planned.name: oracle-database
planned.description: Oracle's own database skills: administration, application development, migrations, PL/SQL, performance, SQLcl and vector search, plus OKE and Functions for OCI.
planned.blockedBy: The skills are UPL-1.0, which is not yet on the registry's licence list (Apache-2.0, MIT, MPL-2.0); the policy decision comes first

planned.name: elastic-observability
planned.description: Elastic's own skills for SRE triage, Kubernetes investigation, ES|QL queries, alert triage and detection rules: logs, observability and SIEM from one vendor.
planned.blockedBy: A new vendor: Elastic joins the registry with its first curated pack, and the votes here say whether teams want it
